## `neuro.string.search`

Instance method on `String.prototype`.

> Finds the first substring match in a regular expression search.

## Signatures

```ts
search(input: { string: <receiver>; regexp: string | RegExp; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
search(input: { string: <receiver>; searcher: { [Symbol.search](string: string): number; }; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `String.prototype.search` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
